name: 500 kW modular UPS

sources.title: Schneider Electric Galaxy VX 500–1500 kW UPS
UK Energy Technology List: Galaxy VX 500 kVA (GVX500K1000NHS)

summary: Three-phase double-conversion UPS block of 500 kW with lithium-ion batteries, scalable in parallel.

moduleW.note: Schneider Galaxy VX scales from 500 kW to 1500 kW.

efficiency.note: Galaxy VX 500 kVA double conversion: 96.7 % at 75 % load and 96.1 % at full load (UK ETL listing); newer Galaxy VXL claims up to 97.5 %.

capexUsdPerKw.note: Judgment for a modular UPS with about 5 minutes of lithium-ion autonomy, equipment only.

leadTimeWeeks.note: Judgment: large three-phase UPS orders were quoted at roughly 4–9 months in 2024–2025.
